reuse.why: Every expected-amount path (preview, posting, forecast, template, balance, API model) goes through the existing getScheduledAmount, and the approximate tolerance reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: The worst-case rule exists once in getScheduledAmount; the API field calls it instead of recomputing, and the tolerance arithmetic is not copied.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the amount helper already was; the API exposure sits in the existing scheduleModel mapper.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule, the API field and tests, with one unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: One clear helper with a documented rule, though callers now thread an untyped op string after a positional `false` inverse flag at every site, which is easy to forget (display sites legitimately omit it).

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planning/posting call sites use getScheduledAmount; no inline min/midpoint logic remains.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the previous rangeRounding variants were removed rather than reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount swapped its rangeRounding parameter for an `op` parameter (net one new parameter replacing one removed) and gained one isapprox branch; all expected-amount call sites route through it; UI display sites call it without op by design.
